title: Requires the Department of Land Conservation and Development to study Oregon's land use system and submit findings to the interim committees of the Legislative Assembly related to land use no later than September 15, 2026.
headline: HB 3602 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3602 was introduced in the House on February 18, 2025.

Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
